title: UniMedVL: Unifying Medical Multimodal Understanding and Generation through Observation-Knowledge-Analysis
claim: One unified model covers many understanding, generation and interleaved tasks across modalities, and matches or beats specialized baselines.
layout: 3 columns: task panels left and right, radar plots center, banner below
description: A dense poster-style overview in three columns. The left column has green cards for understanding tasks (clinical reasoning, disease classification, captioning, report generation) and orange cards for generation tasks (text-to-image, text-to-image with planning). Each card shows a user icon, a prompt bubble, a robot icon and a response bubble, plus medical images. The right column has blue cards for interleaved tasks: segmentation, super-resolution, counterfactual generation, virtual staining and cross-modal synthesis. Each card shows input image, prompt, robot, response and output image. The center column puts the UniMedVL logo with a robot mascot between four radar charts. The charts compare UniMedVL with baselines on understanding, generation, cross-modal synthesis and counterfactual generation. A bottom banner reads '5.6M Samples · 8 Imaging Modalities · 5 Understanding Benchmarks'. The eye goes first to the central logo, then to the surrounding task cards.
caption: Overview of UniMedVL capabilities and benchmark coverage.
abstract: Medical workflows routinely combine reading images with producing visual and textual outputs, making both image understanding and generation central to medical AI. Most existing systems, however, address these abilities in isolated models, losing the shared knowledge that a unified architecture could exploit. To bridge this gap, we present UniMedVL, the first unified medical model that seamlessly integrates multimodal understanding and generation capabilities within a single model without switching weights. We achieve this via a tailored progressive training pipeline where understanding and generation mutually reinforce each other. To effectively train UniMedVL, we curate UniMedVL-5M, the first large-scale medical dataset comprising over 5.6M instances across 8 medical imaging modalities, tailored for multimodal input-output tasks in unified medical understanding and generation. Experimental results demonstrate that UniMedVL achieves competitive performance on five medical understanding benchmarks. Crucially, UniMedVL natively supports diverse interleaved generation tasks, e.g., virtual staining, super-resolution, cross-modal synthesis, essential for complex medical workflows. Our code and dataset are publicly available.
